test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

98 ÷ 7 + 288 × 2 − 144 × 3 − 152 ÷ 2 + 120 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given:

98 ÷ 7 + 288 × 2 − 144 × 3 − 152 ÷ 2 + 120 = ?

**Conditions:**

1. '+' and '-' are interchanged.

2. '×' and '÷' are interchanged.

**Step 1:** Replace the operators according to the given conditions.

The equation becomes: 98 × 7 − 288 ÷ 2 + 144 ÷ 3 + 152 × 2 − 120 = ?
